add.k: Erik's wife in Poland, who knows his secret
st: In Poland, Magda shares a home with Erik, living as Henryk, and their daughter Nina, and wants to stay when his powers are seen.
When the police take Nina into the woods, Magda holds her as the birds attack, and an officer's arrow kills them both.

files.notes: Credited 'Magda' (TMDB cast list for the film: Carolina Bartczak as Magda; Wikipedia's cast prose: 'Erik's wife Magda', its 'Magda Gurzsky' line is commented out). The surname is said on screen only as Erik's alias 'I'm Henryk Gurzsky'. Her lines are from the transcript ('This is our home. This is our daughter's home.'). The arrow follows the app's own Nina file and her wiki page. No group named, so Independent.

add.k: Peter's mother, raising him and his little sister
st: In 1973, Ms. Maximoff takes Charles, Hank and Logan for police at her door, offers to pay for what Peter took, and calls him down.
In 1983, she finds Peter watching news of Magneto and, seeing he will go after him, warns him it will not end well.

files.notes: Credited 'Ms. Maximoff' (Wikipedia, both films). The batch lists only Days of Future Past, but Wikipedia and her wiki page say she returns in Apocalypse, and the transcript has her lines there ('I'm just checking on you', 'Trust me. This won't end well. Nothing does with him'); the speaker split in that exchange is inferred from the subtitles, so the step stays general. No group, so Independent.

add.k: The President of the United States in 1973
st: In 1973, Nixon hears Trask's pitch for the Sentinels and gives him whatever he needs to switch them on.
He unveils them at the White House, until Erik seizes them, and Mystique, posing as him, brings Erik down in the bunker.

files.notes: Credited name Richard Nixon (Wikipedia: Mark Camacho portrays U.S. President Richard Nixon); page_file was null, facts from the cached Marvel Movies plot, Wikipedia and the transcript. The 'Kill me. Fine. But spare everyone else' speech in the bunker is Mystique disguised as Nixon (Marvel Movies plot), so it is not credited to him. Group 'The White House' is the app's existing label for presidents (matthew-ellis) and is said on screen ('The White House has asked all three networks'), though not in groups_in_app. Filed A: he backs the Sentinels but is not shown working against the heroes.

add.k: A spiked mutant who runs with Callisto's gang
st: Kid Omega taunts Magneto at a mutant rally, joins his Brotherhood and guards Jean's old house, where Storm knocks him down.
At Alcatraz, he kills Dr. Rao and throws Warren Worthington II off a roof, then dies in the Phoenix's rampage.

files.notes: Per FILMNAME.md, n is the credited 'Kid Omega' with 'Quill' as alias (Wikipedia: credits erroneously read Kid Omega; the character is Quill). Neither name is said on screen. Real name Maxwell Jordan is from the wiki only, so no rn. Lines from the transcript: 'You talk pretty tough for a guy in a cape' and 'Do we look like we need your help?'. tm follows the app's Callisto file (The Omegas, then The Brotherhood, both keyed to the film). Death in the Phoenix's blast is from the cached Marvel Movies plot. page_file was null.

add.k: The head of Worthington Labs, maker of the mutant cure
st: Warren finds his young son cutting off his wings. Years later, he unveils a mutant cure made at his labs on Alcatraz.
His son flees the cure, and at Alcatraz Kid Omega throws Warren off a roof, until his son flies in and catches him.

files.notes: Credited name (Wikipedia: Michael Murphy as Warren Worthington II). 'Worthington Labs' is said on screen and is in groups_in_app. Lines from the transcript ('I only wanted to help you people'). Filed A: the cure is controversial but he is not shown working against the heroes, and the Brotherhood targets him. He is alive at the end per his wiki page.

st: Madeline comes home to find Bobby with strangers, hears him say he is a mutant, and asks if he has tried not being one.

files.notes: Credited name as the batch and the Marvel Movies cast list give it (Jill Teed); Wikipedia's X2 cast list does not name the parents. The 'not being a mutant' line is attributed to her by her wiki page and is in the transcript. Her wiki page says the police held the parents hostage; the transcript only shows officers ordering everyone down, so the step leaves that out. No group, so Independent.

st: William finds Logan in his kitchen and demands to know who he is, then hears his son Bobby say he is a mutant.

files.notes: Credited 'William Drake': Wikipedia's Alf Humphreys filmography ('X2 (2003) – William Drake') and the TMDB X2 cast list agree with the Marvel Movies cast list; no source gives 'Bill Drake'. 'Who the hell are you?' and the school for the gifted line are from the transcript and his wiki page. No group, so Independent.

add.k: The President of the United States
st: McKenna survives a mutant attack in the Oval Office, then authorizes Stryker's operation against Xavier's school.
The X-Men freeze his office before an address, and McKenna takes Stryker's files as Xavier warns him a war is coming.

files.notes: Credited 'President McKenna' (TMDB cast list for X2; Wikipedia's Cotter Smith filmography: X2, President McKenna). He is only called 'Mr President' on screen. Approval of Stryker's operation is from Wikipedia's plot ('receives approval') and the transcript ('Your authorisation for a special operation'). Group 'The White House' is the app's label for presidents (Matthew Ellis), though not in groups_in_app.

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Living as Henryk Gurzsky in Poland, Erik married Magda and told her who he was the night they met. When his powers are seen, he wants to flee and she wants to stay, then the police come and she dies with Nina.
stages.whoA: Her husband, living as Henryk Gurzsky
stages.whoB: His wife in Poland, who knew his secret

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Magda goes to fetch Nina when Erik says they must leave, and finds her gone. In the woods she holds her frightened daughter as Nina's birds attack the police, and one arrow kills them both.
stages.whoA: Her young daughter
stages.whoB: Her mother

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: When three strangers come asking for Peter, his mother takes them for police again and calls him down. She offers to write a check for whatever he took.
stages.whoA: Her speedster son, often in trouble
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: X-Men: Apocalypse
stages.text: Ten years later, she checks on Peter at home as the news reports Magneto's attack. She sees he means to go after him and warns that nothing ends well with him.
stages.whoA: Her son, set on finding Magneto
stages.whoB: His mother, who warns him off Magneto

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Trask warns Nixon that Mystique could pose as anyone, even him, and pitches his Sentinels, and Nixon gives him whatever he needs. After the unveiling goes wrong, Nixon rages in the bunker that the world now knows they cannot protect it.
stages.whoA: His adviser on the Sentinels
stages.whoB: The President who backs his Sentinels

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Erik turns the Sentinels on the crowd at Nixon's unveiling and tears the bunker out of the White House with Nixon inside. He tells the world that mutants are the future before Mystique stops him.
stages.whoA: The mutant who seizes his Sentinels
stages.whoB: The President he holds at his mercy

stages.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past
stages.text: Mystique slips into Nixon's bunker as a Secret Service agent. When Erik holds everyone at his mercy, she takes Nixon's form, brings Erik down with a plastic gun and spares Trask, saving the President.
stages.whoA: The mutant who saves his life
stages.whoB: The President she saves from Erik

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Kid Omega mocks Magneto as a tough talker in a cape at his rally, then follows him into the Brotherhood. Magneto sends him to Jean's house and later into Worthington Labs at Alcatraz.
stages.whoA: The leader he follows into battle
stages.whoB: An Omega who joins his Brotherhood

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Callisto leads Kid Omega's gang to Magneto's rally, and they join the Brotherhood together. They stand guard at Jean's house and storm Alcatraz side by side.
stages.whoA: The leader of his gang
stages.whoB: A spiked member of her gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: At the rally, Kid Omega pops his spikes as Pyro lights a fireball, until their leaders stop them. Soon both fight for Magneto's Brotherhood.
stages.whoA: Magneto's fire wielder, later a teammate
stages.whoB: The Omega who squares off with him

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Storm swoops down outside Jean's house and knocks Kid Omega and Arclight down before she takes on Callisto.
stages.whoA: The X-Man who knocks him down
stages.whoB: A Brotherhood mutant she knocks down

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: At Alcatraz, Kid Omega grabs Dr. Rao as she begs for Warren Worthington II's life, hugs her and kills her with his spikes.
stages.whoA: The scientist he kills
stages.whoB: The mutant who kills her

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Warren finds his young son trying to cut off his wings. Years later, he brings Warren in as the first to take the cure, but Warren breaks free and flies away. At Alcatraz, his son catches him in midair when he is thrown off a roof.
stages.whoA: His winged son
stages.whoB: His father, who made the cure

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Dr. Rao works on the cure at Worthington Labs and readies the injection for Warren's son. When the Brotherhood storms Alcatraz, the two flee together until Kid Omega kills her.
stages.whoA: His scientist on the cure
stages.whoB: Her employer, head of Worthington Labs

stages.title: X-Men: The Last Stand
stages.text: Kid Omega corners Warren and Dr. Rao inside the labs at Alcatraz. When Warren says he only wanted to help, Kid Omega asks if they look like they need help, and Warren is thrown off the roof.
stages.whoA: The mutant who throws him off a roof
stages.whoB: The maker of the cure he tries to kill

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Bobby comes home with Logan, Rogue and John and tells his parents he is a mutant. Madeline struggles with the news and asks if he has tried not being one. Ronny's call brings the police, and Bobby leaves with the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Her son, who tells her he is a mutant
stages.whoB: His mother, who struggles with the news

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Madeline and William come home to find a stranger in their kitchen. Together they hear Bobby say he is a mutant, and admit they thought he was at a school for the gifted.
stages.whoA: Her husband
stages.whoB: His wife

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Madeline and her younger son Ronny hear Bobby say he is a mutant. Ronny secretly calls the police, who break into the house.
stages.whoA: Her younger son
stages.whoB: His mother

stages.title: X2
stages.text: William demands to know who the stranger in his kitchen is, and Bobby says he is Professor Logan. William thought Bobby was at a school for the gifted, and the news that his son is a mutant leaves him at a loss before the police arrive.
stages.whoA: His son, who tells him he is a mutant
stages.whoB: His father

stages.title: X2
stages.text: William and his younger son Ronny come home to find Logan in the kitchen and hear Bobby's news. Ronny then calls the police on his brother.
stages.whoA: His younger son
stages.whoB: His father

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Under Stryker's control, Kurt teleports through the White House and nearly kills McKenna, leaving a knife marked for mutant freedom before he is shot and escapes. Later he stands with the X-Men in McKenna's office.
stages.whoA: The mutant who tried to kill him
stages.whoB: The President he was forced to attack

stages.title: X2
stages.text: After the attack, Stryker asks McKenna to authorize a special operation and shows him evidence of a mutant training facility in upstate New York. McKenna lets him go ahead, and later the X-Men hand him Stryker's files.
stages.whoA: The colonel whose raid he approves
stages.whoB: The President who approves his raid

stages.title: X2
stages.text: Xavier freezes McKenna's office before an address and hands him Stryker's private files. He warns that a war is coming and that humans and mutants must work together, and leaves the next move to McKenna.
stages.whoA: The mutant who brings him Stryker's files
stages.whoB: The President he warns of war

changes.why: Use the credited name: the film credits her as Magda, and Wikipedia's cast list calls her Erik's wife Magda.
Use the credited name: the cast list credits Cotter Smith as President McKenna.
